scope: Local-only Argon Priority support, distinct one-prompt object generation, compact lossless geometry, temporary streamed 3D preview, honest service-tier/usage timings and bounded live comparisons. No deployment.

integrations.purpose: Generate a unique editable object from one prompt with measured Priority support and unchanged validation.

checks.expected: Interactions transport handles streaming, text-only extraction, attachments, actual tier, errors and cancellation.
checks.observed: Interactions request/stream tests pass, including stateless text/PDF/image mapping, actual/downgraded tier, split UTF-8, thought exclusion, truncation, errors, terminal events and cancellation. These are mocked protocol checks.

checks.expected: All regression tests, TypeScript and production build pass.
checks.observed: 222 tests passed; two opt-in paid-provider tests skipped in the normal suite. TypeScript and the final Next.js production build passed.

checks.expected: Same-prompt Standard/Priority generation completes with validated custom geometry and observed timings/usage.
checks.observed: Real same-prompt calls each returned valid 14-part cassette assemblies. Standard 99.109s vs actual Priority 91.178s in one pair. A later compact run was slower at 107.644s; no general speed or quality superiority is claimed.

checks.expected: Failed/truncated responses preserve the current assembly and never substitute a shared template.
checks.observed: Mocked stream failures do not return a complete result, invalid component graphs are rejected, cancellation aborts, and custom generation refuses the former keyboard-template shortcut. Current geometry is committed only after validation.

checks.expected: Local browser creates, selects, edits and undoes a newly generated object.
checks.observed: Real Argon generated a new six-part, 51-solid lamp in 45.712s. Two parts were visibly fitted by the sampled 18s observation. Direct 3D arm selection worked. A base X edit changed 0 to 12 mm; exported Undo matched the complete original document exactly.

checks.expected: Compact geometry preserves all coordinates/materials and the temporary preview rejects invalid or over-budget components.
checks.observed: Codec round-trip, malformed geometry, unique IDs, scene budgets and transient preview guards pass. Exact baseline re-encoding saved 21.6% of JSON bytes with the same 121 solids.

checks.expected: Original sibling stays clean and local-only boundaries are preserved.
checks.observed: The original sibling working tree remains clean at its preserved revision. No push or deployment was made.
